name: glean-email-responder
description: DOM-first Chrome extension and backend for drafting Gmail replies with Glean.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @gmail-glean-reply-drafter/shared && npm run build -w @gmail-glean-reply-drafter/backend && npm run build -w @gmail-glean-reply-drafter/extension && npm run build -w @gmail-glean-reply-drafter/helper-app
scripts.clean: rm -rf backend/dist extension/dist helper-app/dist shared/dist outputs
scripts.release:helper:mac: npm run package:helper:mac && npm run archive:helper:mac
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @gmail-glean-reply-drafter/shared && npm run typecheck -w @gmail-glean-reply-drafter/backend && npm run typecheck -w @gmail-glean-reply-drafter/extension && npm run typecheck -w @gmail-glean-reply-drafter/helper-app
